messages:
rebecca: Quick sync: Stagelock enterprise trial — go/no-go checklist for Wed cutover. Need owners for infra, SDK, and security deliverables. TL;DR: canary ready? @ajay @marta
ajay: Infra update — staging cluster up, but we still need the NAT rule from their VPC peering. Filed ticket SE-412. ETA for terraform change: Tue EOD.

marta: SE/integration: SDK keys are provisioned but their callback endpoint wants a custom auth header. PR open: https://git.redwood/integrations/stagelock/pull/27 — pinging @lucas for review.

lucas: On review now, should be quick. Also noted CORS header missing for /events, will add Access-Control-Allow-Origin.

sara: QA here — test plan drafted. Success criteria for go: 95% sample prompts <300ms median latency, auth flows <1% error, and end-to-end smoke pass. I'll run smoke after PR merge.

pranav: Runtime note — enabling model-variant fallback to avoid timeouts during capacity spikes. Patch added to runtime config: 
```
fallback:
  policy: 'variant-prefer-small'
  max_retries: 2
```
Planned deploy Wed 03:00 UTC, canary 5%.

rebecca: Owners summary: infra=ajay, integration=marta, review=lucas, qa=sara, runtime=pranav. @sara can you run the smoke tests by Tue 11:00 UTC so sales demo on Wed looks good?

sara: :thumbsup: will run tests Tue morning. Any legal/data privacy flags? @rebecca

rebecca: Legal did a quick pass — DPA standard OK, but we must mask PII in logs. @ajay please add log redaction at the ingress.

ajay: Will add redaction rule in nginx ingress. Example snippet to hook in: 
```
nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/server-snippet: |\n  if ($request_body ~* "(ssn|email)") { set $masked 1; }
```
ETA Tue morning.

marta: FYI sales doc updated with deliverables & timeline: https://docs.redwood.com/stagelock-poc (owners + checklist).

rebecca: Great. If no blockers after reviews, plan stands. I'll post final go/no-go by Tue 14:00 UTC. /cc @deploy-bot

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled canary deploy for stagelock at 2025-09-03T03:00:00Z (5% traffic).

lucas: Merged the PR and fixed the callback auth header handling. Deployed to stage, running a few test payloads now.
